name: Hopward
storyline:
Legends tell of a golden crown hidden high above the clouds a crown said to grant any wish.
Drawn by its promise, countless souls began their climb toward the heavens. None ever returned.
Now, a small frog takes the leap, determined to reach what others could not.
Each fall brings doubt. Each jump brings hope.
Some chase glory. Others chase dreams. But only one may reach the crown.
summary:
Hopward is a precision platformer where you play as a determined little frog climbing toward the sky. Charge your jumps, dive through the air, and test your patience as every leap brings you closer to the top or all the way back to the bottom. Explore vibrant worlds from rainy ponds to wizard towers, floating gardens, and mystical skies.
No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just you, your timing, and the fall.
